items.source_en:
There are years where nothing happens, and years that can define a life. I was sixteen when I first took to the skies. Seventeen when it all came crashing down.

It began with a ship. Earlier that year, my father had salvaged a wreck from the war, a B class Sienar Technologies fighter from an abandoned staryard. It was old, outdated, and to put it bluntly, a piece of junk. The controls were shaky, the plating was rusted, and the engine coughed like it had a bad lung. 

But none of that mattered to me. I was hooked from the very first hyperspace jump. 

You see, up until that point, I had often struggled to focus. Nothing I did had any long term appeal. That all changed the moment I took that Sienar Technologies junker out to the spacelanes. For the first time in my life, I could see a life for me beyond the present. This ship, for all its loose wires, dents, and pockmarks, gave me purpose. Something I could devote my life to.

Three months later I was an escort for my father's freighter. 

Ten months later, we were attacked by the Shadow Collective.

Most days, I think about my father -- the kind, gentle man who raised me. I think about how much poorer this galaxy is without his laughter soaring through its membrane. And other times, my thoughts turn to his son, the boy with the star-bright eyes, and the future he lost. 

When I am confronted by this boy. my resolve begins to wane. I want him to forgive me for the man I've become, one consumed by hate and vengeance. I stand wordless as he tugs at the corners of my jacket, tears flowing down his cheeks, begging me to let my anger go. And in that moment, every part of me wants to embrace him, and tell him exactly what he needs to hear. I want to tell him I will drop this accursed chase, and give his future the chance it deserves.

But instead, I turn away. I leave him crying, alone in the void of space. But what he does not realize, is that I am doing this for him. I fight the Shadow Collective for all the fathers and futures lost to a world that never should have been. And when I think of them, my resolve returns, and I have purpose once more.
items.legacy_ko:
아무 일도 일어나지 않는 해가 있는가 하면, 인생을 결정짓는 해가 있습니다. 제가 처음 하늘을 날았을 때가 열여섯이었습니다. 모든 것이 무너져 내렸을 때는 열일곱이었죠.

함선 한 척으로 시작되었습니다. 그해 초, 아버지는 버려진 조선소에서 전쟁 때 쓰던 B급 시에나 테크놀로지 전투기 잔해를 인양하셨습니다. 낡고 구식이었으며, 솔직히 말해 고철 덩어리였습니다. 조종 장치는 흔들리고, 외판은 녹슬었으며, 엔진은 폐병 환자처럼 쿨럭거렸죠.

하지만 제게는 아무 상관 없었습니다. 첫 초공간 도약부터 완전히 매료되었으니까요.

그전까지 저는 집중하는 데 어려움을 겪곤 했습니다. 제가 하는 일 중 그 무엇도 장기적인 매력을 주지 못했죠. 하지만 그 시에나 테크놀로지 고철을 타고 우주 항로로 나선 순간 모든 것이 바뀌었습니다. 인생 처음으로 현재 너머의 삶을 볼 수 있었습니다. 느슨한 전선과 찌그러진 자국, 흠집투성이인 이 함선이 제게 목적을 주었습니다. 제 인생을 바칠 수 있는 무언가를요.

3개월 후 저는 아버지의 화물선을 호위하게 되었습니다.

10개월 후, 우리는 섀도우 컬렉티브의 습격을 받았습니다.

대부분의 날, 저는 저를 길러주신 다정하고 온화한 아버지에 대해 생각합니다. 그분의 웃음소리가 은하계의 막을 가로질러 울려 퍼지지 않는 지금, 이 은하계가 얼마나 빈곤해졌는지 생각합니다. 또 어떤 때는 별처럼 빛나는 눈을 가진 그분의 아들, 그 아이가 잃어버린 미래에 대해 생각합니다.

그 아이와 마주할 때면 제 결심은 흔들리기 시작합니다. 증오와 복수심에 사로잡힌 저를 용서해 달라고 말하고 싶어집니다. 아이가 제 재킷 자락을 잡아당기며 눈물을 흘리며 제발 분노를 거두어 달라고 애원할 때, 저는 아무 말도 하지 못한 채 서 있습니다. 그 순간, 온몸이 아이를 껴안고 아이가 듣고 싶어 하는 말을 그대로 해주고 싶어집니다. 이 저주받은 추격을 멈추고 아이의 미래에 마땅한 기회를 주겠다고 말하고 싶습니다.

하지만 저는 고개를 돌립니다. 아이를 우주의 공허 속에 홀로 울게 내버려 둡니다. 하지만 아이는 모릅니다. 제가 이 모든 일을 아이를 위해 하고 있다는 것을요. 저는 결코 존재해서는 안 될 세상에 잃어버린 모든 아버지와 미래를 위해 섀도우 컬렉티브와 싸웁니다. 그들을 생각하면 제 결심은 다시 돌아오고, 저는 다시 한번 목적을 갖게 됩니다.

하지만 저는 고개를 돌립니다. 아이를 우주의 공허 속에 홀로 울게 내버려 둡니다. 하지만 아이는 모릅니다. 제가 이 모든 일을 아이를 위해 하고 있다는 것을요. 저는 결코 존재해서는 안 될 세상에 잃어버린 모든 아버지와 미래를 위해 섀도우 컬렉티브와 싸웁니다. 그들을 생각하면 제 결심은 다시 돌아오고, 저는 다시 한번 목적을 갖게 됩니다.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
There are years where nothing happens, and years that can define a life. I was sixteen when I first took to the skies. Seventeen when it all came crashing down.

It began with a ship. Earlier that year, my father had salvaged a wreck from the war, a B class Deimos fighter from an abandoned staryard. It was old, outdated, and to put it bluntly, a piece of junk. The controls were shaky, the plating was rusted, and the engine coughed like it had a bad lung. 

But none of that mattered to me. I was hooked from the very first grav jump. 

You see, up until that point, I had often struggled to focus. Nothing I did had any long term appeal. That all changed the moment I took that Deimos junker out to the spacelanes. For the first time in my life, I could see a life for me beyond the present. This ship, for all its loose wires, dents, and pockmarks, gave me purpose. Something I could devote my life to.

Three months later I was an escort for my father's freighter. 

Ten months later, we were attacked by the Crimson Fleet.

Most days, I think about my father -- the kind, gentle man who raised me. I think about how much poorer this galaxy is without his laughter soaring through its membrane. And other times, my thoughts turn to his son, the boy with the star-bright eyes, and the future he lost. 

When I am confronted by this boy. my resolve begins to wane. I want him to forgive me for the man I've become, one consumed by hate and vengeance. I stand wordless as he tugs at the corners of my jacket, tears flowing down his cheeks, begging me to let my anger go. And in that moment, every part of me wants to embrace him, and tell him exactly what he needs to hear. I want to tell him I will drop this accursed chase, and give his future the chance it deserves.

But instead, I turn away. I leave him crying, alone in the void of space. But what he does not realize, is that I am doing this for him. I fight the Crimson Fleet for all the fathers and futures lost to a world that never should have been. And when I think of them, my resolve returns, and I have purpose once more.

items.source_en:
It's loose! The Rakghoul is loose! We can't stop it!

When we tried to sync with the Neural Control Interface it just completely flipped out. Broke through its containment chamber like it was made out of paper.

It killed Michelson, Cobb and Sumatri in all of one minute.

I'm not even sure where it is now. It took off deeper into the facility. A security detail went after it, but good friggin' luck.

When I know it's safe I'm going to make a run for the comm relay, try to call in the cavalry.

This is Hayden Wynn, lead xenobiologist, wishing he had gone to dentist school like his parents wanted.
items.legacy_ko:
풀려났어! 락굴이 풀려났다고! 막을 수가 없어!

신경 제어 인터페이스와 동기화하려 했을 때 녀석이 완전히 날뛰기 시작했어. 격리실을 종잇장처럼 뚫고 나와 버렸다고.

미첼슨, 콥, 수마트리를 1분도 안 돼서 죽여버렸어.

지금 어디 있는지조차 모르겠어. 시설 깊숙한 곳으로 사라졌거든. 보안팀이 뒤를 쫓았지만, 행운을 빌어줄 수밖에 없겠지.

안전이 확인되면 통신 중계기로 달려가서 지원군을 요청해 볼 생각이야.

수석 외계 생물학자 헤이든 윈이다. 부모님 말씀대로 치과 대학에나 갈 걸 그랬어.
